sections.title: Usage
items: The result of the currently focused input box is output in the result box at the bottom of the window
To add another input box, press enter
To remove an input box, press backspace when the box is empty
Input boxes can be easily navigated using the up and down arrow keys

sections.title: Values
items: Variables defined in the format [a-Z] on their own or followed by a subscript number, e.g., x or x0

sections.title: Notation
items: All statements must be closed by a semi-colon (;)
Multiplication must explicitly include the multiplication symbol and not be shorthand, e.g., a * b not ab
Functions must be of the form [a-Z](x) and can include an optional set hint, e.g., f(x : N) = 2 * x
Equations of a line must be of the form y = mx + c or x = my + c
